title: Before Ten
subtitle: The statement has not landed. A composite CFO must brief the chair while the RBI home page still shows 5.25%.
category: Monetary Policy, Working Capital and CFO Judgment
description: HBS-style teaching case dated the morning of 7 October 2026, before Governor Sanjay Malhotra's 10:00 IST statement. Composite firm: Mahanadi Alloys. Composite decision-maker: CFO Arjun Mehta. Public record: RBI home-page rates still at repo 5.25%; Reuters poll 18-28 September (35 of 61 for +25 bps); August CPI 4.82%; FBIL USD/INR 96.4348 as at 13:00 on 6 October; RBI money-market operations as on 5 October.
thumbnail: THE STATEMENT HAS NOT LANDED. THE WEBSITE STILL SAYS 5.25%.
sources: Reserve Bank of India home page, current policy rates, consulted on the morning of 7 October 2026: repo 5.25%, SDF 5.00%, MSF 5.50%, Bank Rate 5.50%, CRR 3.00%, SLR 18.00%.
Reuters, Pranoy Krishna, 28 September 2026: 35 of 61 economists expected a 25 bp hike to 5.50% at the 5-7 October meeting.
Reuters, 14 September 2026: August CPI 4.82%, July 4.45%, food inflation 5.95%.
FBIL exchange rates as published on the RBI home page, as at 13:00 on 6 October 2026: USD/INR 96.4348.
RBI press release, 6 October 2026, Money Market Operations as on 5 October 2026.
The Hindu BusinessLine, 5 October 2026: MPC opens amid expectations of the first hike since 2023; Brent cited near $101.26.
